arguments.text: Stage 2 implementation in work.py compares canonical complete JSON states for every unique declared non-ignored path, treats an absent mapping entry as {kind:missing}, sorts changed paths, sets needs_review from changed, and does not mutate inputs. Independent boundary checks covered duplicates, ignored paths, missing equivalence, nested key-order canonicalization, array-order changes, irrelevant paths, and input immutability; all passed.

Current report.json was verified equal to evaluating every request in requests.json under policy.json. evidence.json is absent. Known limit: inputs are expected to be JSON-compatible; non-finite numbers are rejected by canonicalization and remain outside tested conditions.
